name: ryzhy_rope
prompt: Game sprite sheet: 8 animation frames of ONE continuous looping skipping-rope animation in a grid of 2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first, generous empty space between frames, never mirror a frame. Character: the orange tabby tomcat Ryzhy, exactly as in the FIRST reference (same proportions, colours, face), standing upright on the hind legs, body and face turned to the viewer at three-quarter view slightly to the right, EXACTLY the same camera angle in all 8 frames (like the cat in the second reference) - never in profile, never sideways. The feet are on the same ground line in every frame except frame 5. Comic book style exactly like the references: bold black ink outlines, flat colours with simple shading and light hatching. IMPORTANT: the background of the whole sheet MUST be solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) everywhere, no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers. Do not use green on the character.
